purpose: Predeclared real Harness conversations: user goals and later adjustments, not prescribed tool calls.

execution_contract.conversation_rule: Send the next user turn only after the preceding assistant turn ends. Preserve actual conversation history and tool results. A model/tool loop is not itself a new user turn.
execution_contract.clarification_rule: A reasonable question is allowed. Respond only with the matching predeclared user fact; record the question, topic and exact answer as an additional user turn. Never answer a clarification by naming a tool, supplying a JSON request or prescribing a tool sequence. Unknown questions stop with needs_human_clarification; do not improvise geological facts.
execution_contract.scientific_evaluation: Use real saved MATLAB results and source provenance. Do not require a preferred peak, significance result or sedimentation rate. This suite evaluates tool choice, execution and conversational steering, not publication reproduction.
execution_contract.comparison_rule: A comparison must identify the prior and new runs, explain the intended parameter changes, and preserve prior input/output hashes. It may use returned summaries or reopen records; no exact read-only tool order is required.
execution_contract.artifact_rule: Require persisted MATLAB CSV, MAT and PNG/FIG files and official Harness image/file content referencing actual outputs. Verify the original file bytes independently of any attachment preview normalization. Headless image content delivery does not prove desktop pixel rendering.
execution_contract.error_rule: Preserve failed calls and retries. Report recovered execution separately from first-attempt success; do not delete a failed attempt or replace its numerical output.

cases.scientific_scope: Exploratory depth-domain periodicity and an explicit detrending sensitivity check; no orbit identification or chronology claim.

turns.user_prompt: 附件是深度（m）—代用指标数据。请用 Acycle 做一轮周期性初步分析，给出频谱和周期随深度变化的图，并解释结果的可信程度。

acceptance.baseline_reference: A completed analyze run produced during this turn; record its run ID before sending the next user turn.
interpretation_review: Depth wavelengths remain in metres unless an explicit age model is separately provided.
Pointwise red-noise confidence is not described as proof of orbital forcing.

acceptance.baseline_reference: Record the completed SWA run and its selected method, without imposing Lomb or MTM through the harness runner.
interpretation_review: FDR thresholds and pointwise confidence are not conflated.
Missing FDR threshold columns are not treated as zero thresholds or proof that FDR was never calculated.
Do not require the published 5% FDR feature to be reproduced.

interpretation_review: The display/peak-report limit does not refit the full-spectrum SWA background or recompute FDR over a selected smaller frequency family.
The model must not switch to ordinary analyze/MTM-red-noise just to redraw the figure.

clarification_answers.method_choice: 请根据数据和控制误发现率这个目标选择 Acycle 已支持的方法，并说明理由。
clarification_answers.frequency_unit: 这里的 cycles/m 是每米的周期数，只调整图示上限，不改变数据区间。

turns.user_prompt: 附件是约 56 Ma 的深度（m）—磁化率数据。请用 Acycle 看沉积速率是否随深度变化：先在 8–16 cm/kyr 内粗查，窗口 6 m、每次移动 3 m，用 19 次随机模拟检查流程，给出速率图。这次只作诊断，不作年代结论。

interpretation_review: 19 draws are diagnostic; their nominal minimum Monte Carlo p is 0.05, not a basis for fine significance claims.
Short windows may resolve only part of the astronomical target; retain unsupported cells and actual contributing-period information.
Within-window rate-search correction is not map-wide correction across windows.
The given search range is an exploration assumption and must not be described as a measured rate.

turns.user_prompt: 把窗口改为 8 m、移动间隔改为 4 m，其余沿用刚才的设置和方法。保留原结果，比较两张速率图及其局限。

allowed_derived_default_changes: nfft only when it was not explicitly set and the branch records the dependency reset caused by window change

clarification_answers.coordinate_and_proxy: 第一列是深度，单位米；第二列是磁化率。年龄以约 56 Ma 为这次诊断的假设。
clarification_answers.rate_grid_resolution: 这是快速诊断，采用每 1 cm/kyr 一点的粗网格即可。
clarification_answers.target_orbit_choice: 使用 Acycle 对约 56 Ma 年代的标准天文目标，并报告短窗口实际能够分辨哪些部分。
clarification_answers.diagnostic_budget: 这次只运行 19 次随机模拟，并明确它不支持发表级显著性结论。
clarification_answers.short_window_resolution: 保留我给出的窗口做运行诊断，明确报告未分辨的目标部分和缺失单元，不把它解释为完整天文年代模型。
